source.section: Form 1040ME lines 14-20 (PDF pp.1-2); line 17 Maine Standard Deduction Chart (booklet PDF p.5); line 13 table and line 18 (PDF p.5); 2025 Tax Rate Schedules (PDF p.13). Record cite: base.deductions, booklet PDF page 5 (chart, worksheet, line 13 table), PDF page 6 (exemption phaseout worksheet), PDF page 11 Quick Facts; brackets PDF page 13; line 12a box, 65 or over

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 50,010.00 = 50,010.00. Federal taxable income = 50,010.00 - 15,750.00 standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 for 65 or older = 32,260.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 1040ME, single: line 14 federal AGI 50,010.00. Schedule 1A line 1 (PDF p.7) other-state municipal bond interest 0.00; Schedule 1A total = line 15a 0.00. Schedule 1S line 3 (PDF p.7) taxable Social Security 0.00 + railroad retirement 0.00 = 0.00. Schedule 1S line 4 pension income deduction 0.00 (no eligible pension income). Schedule 1S line 27 total subtractions = 0.00 + 0.00 = line 15b 0.00. Line 16 Maine AGI = 50,010.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 50,010.00. Line 17 standard deduction (person 0 born 1961-01-01 is 65 at December 31, 2025; 1 box(es) on lines 12a-12d): chart (PDF p.5) 17,000.00 = base 15,000.00 + 1 x 2,000.00; Maine AGI not over 100,000.00, so no worksheet; line 17 = 17,000.00. Line 13 = 1; line 18 exemption = 1 x 5,150.00 = 5,150.00 (Maine AGI not over 333,450.00). Line 19 taxable income = 50,010.00 - 17,000.00 - 5,150.00 = 27,860.00. Line 20 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.13): 5.8% x (26,800.00 - 0.00) = 1,554.40 + 6.75% x (27,860.00 - 26,800.00) = 71.55 = 1,625.95. The booklet's tax table (PDF pp.12-13) row 27,800.00 to 27,900.00 gives 1,625; expected keeps the schedule formula. Line 23 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 24 Maine income tax 1,625.95.
accepted_approximations: Tax is computed from the rate schedules as numbers. The booklet's table taxes 100-dollar rows and the printed schedule constants are rounded to dollars.
